svg.title: White Relief over Dark Blue, 2002 — interpretive SVG study
svg.desc: Two adjacent rectangles form a stepped silhouette. White-painted panel is opaque; empty upper-right area is transparent. Shallow relief thickness/shadows omitted.
svg.metadata: Primary record: https://hirshhorn.si.edu/collection/artwork/?edanUrl=edanmdm%3Ahmsg_07.32; visual reference: https://ids.si.edu/ids/deliveryService?id=HMSG-HMSG-07.32; reviewed 2026-10-27; hand-authored interpretive study, not a facsimile; approximate geometry and standardized screen colours.
